summary: [engine behavior] H2-1 (design 18.4, "The runner is the only route (S2.2, H2-1)") does not hold: COMMAND_TOOLS (lib/greenfield/index.js:52, refused at index.js:107-114) lists only evidence_run, fix_verify, mutate and the five lab tools, but other frozen tools of the same role-locked server still run project commands and project code for a group role in a Greenfield-Senior project, outside the runner: guard_migration with proof:true (lib/guards/migration.js:153-176 runs the configured seed, downgrade and upgrade), security_matrix, security_idor, security_authflow and security_input (lib/security.js:94-107 run the configured setup and import the app), guard_api (lib/guards/api.js:172-205 imports the app in both worktrees), guard_perf and guard_race. Each runs through evidence.runCommand in a git worktree of the real repository (lib/worktree.js:16-42) whose dependency directories (.venv, venv, node_modules, vendor) are SYMLINKS to the real tree, under the frozen windows only: no copy, no hash of the real tree, no .eccode/ check. The installer gives every role all of its server's tools (lib/install.js:160-173), the hook only checks that the caller uses its own server (scripts/hooks/guard.js:374-378), and the engine's own delivery messages tell the owner to run them (migration.js:208 'eccode guard migration --proof --actor <owner>', security.js:302), so the database-engineer running the required rollback proof is the normal flow. Reproduction review-i/i2-1-guard-tools.test.js: as database-engineer, guard_migration {proof:true} runs the db group's seed and security_matrix runs the configured setup; that project code writes .eccode/drafts/frontend/note.md and web/seeded.json by absolute path and .venv/seed-marker by a RELATIVE path (through the worktree's .venv symlink), all three land in the real tree, no GF-RUN-2 refusal, and security_matrix reports success. The control in the same file runs the same seed through gf_run: exit 99, and the relative write stays in the copy. Both prevention (relative path) and detection (absolute path, .eccode/) of 18.0 are bypassed through the engine's own surface, which is the class H2-1 was raised for.
